title: Tongue Emoji 👅 Meaning: Tasty, Teasing or Something Dirty
description: 👅 can mean delicious food, playful teasing or licking in a sexual sense. Learn how context changes the tongue emoji and why it differs from 😛 and 😋.
summary: 👅 is a pink tongue sticking out. It is used for tasting and delicious food, for silly teasing, and very commonly for sexual innuendo involving licking or oral sex. Without a face attached it reads as more physical and suggestive than tongue-out smileys like 😛.
meaning: A tongue with no face around it is hard to read as innocent, and most people do not try. In flirtatious and explicit messages, 👅 refers to licking, kissing with tongue or oral sex, and it is one of the standard building blocks of sexting alongside 💦, 🍑 and 🍆. Under a thirst-trap photo it means the commenter finds the person mouth-wateringly attractive.

The wholesome uses are real, just less dominant. Food lovers post 👅 for something that tastes amazing, particularly ice cream, lollipops and anything you would actually lick. Pet owners use it for dogs and cats giving kisses or caught mid-blep. And it can be a cheeky “nyah nyah,” sticking your tongue out at someone, although face emojis such as 😛 or 😜 handle that job with less risk of misreading.

Music and fashion gave it another association. A protruding tongue is a rock-and-roll image, tied to wild, rebellious performance, and people use 👅 in posts about concerts, tattoos, piercings and loud aesthetics. Tongue piercings and the split-tongue look in body modification communities get the emoji for obvious literal reasons. In these posts it stands for attitude and appetite for excess more than for anything explicitly sexual.

It also appears in face mashups. 👁️👅👁️ swaps the neutral mouth of the stare meme for a tongue, producing a derpy or thirsty expression. Because the emoji’s reputation is mostly suggestive, even the playful versions carry a hint of innuendo, which is often exactly the joke. Brands that want to seem cheeky sometimes use it for that reason, with mixed results, since the audience may read more into it than intended.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Between partners, 👅 is rarely subtle. It signals desire and usually points at something specific. Between friends it may be a joke about how good a meal looks or an exaggerated reaction to an attractive celebrity. If someone you barely know sends it, they are being forward, and it is reasonable to treat it that way.

contexts.label: On TikTok and Instagram
contexts.body: Thirst comments use 👅 heavily, often in combination with 💦 or 🥵. Food creators use it on dessert and street-food videos, and pet accounts on clips of animals licking the camera. Because platforms are public, the same emoji under a stranger’s selfie can feel invasive rather than complimentary. Context from the video usually makes the intended meaning plain.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: There is little ambiguity here. A crush who sends 👅 in response to your photo or as part of a flirty exchange is expressing sexual attraction, not just friendliness. If that is welcome, it is an opening. If it is not, the emoji is explicit enough that you are justified in saying so.

combos.meaning: Explicit reference to oral sex or intense lust; also drooling over food.
Licking ice cream, either literally or as a suggestive joke.
A goofy or thirsty version of the blank stare face.

confusedWith.difference: 😛 is a smiling face sticking its tongue out, clearly playful and childish. 👅 has no face, which removes the innocence and makes it look more physical and suggestive.
😋 licks its lips over tasty food and is the safe choice for meals. 👅 can mean delicious too, but it is far more likely to be read as innuendo.
👄 shows closed lips and suggests kissing, speech or lipstick. 👅 is the tongue alone and points to licking and tasting. Lips suggest romance; a tongue suggests appetite.

avoid: Do not use it in work chats or with people you know only casually.
Avoid posting it under strangers’ photos, where it comes across as sexual harassment rather than a compliment.
For food posts aimed at a general audience, pick 😋 or 🤤 if you want to avoid double meanings.
design: The glyph is a pink tongue extending downward, usually from a hint of an open mouth or lips at the top, with a center line running along it. Apple, Google, Samsung and Microsoft all follow this layout with small differences in color and how much of the mouth is shown. It has no skin tone options.

faqs.q: What does 👅 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: In most cases it is sexual or strongly flirtatious: he is attracted to you or hinting at something physical. If you were talking about food or pets, take it literally. From a guy you do not know well, it is a bold message, not a neutral one.

faqs.q: What does 👅 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: It can be flirting, a suggestive joke, or a reaction to something delicious. Girls also send it to friends when hyping up their photos, where it is exaggerated praise rather than romantic interest. Topic and relationship tell you which reading applies.
Yes. 😛 is a goofy face and nearly always harmless. 👅 isolates the tongue, so it is used for licking, tasting and sexual innuendo. If you only want to be silly, the face version is the safer choice.

The combination usually refers to oral sex or to being extremely turned on, with the droplets representing fluids. In a food context it can mean drooling over something tasty, but most people will assume the sexual meaning first.
